profile.name: Recruiting & Enrollment Lead
profile.description: Grows your field the healthy way: tracks how many people join each week and market, finds where would-be reps drop out before finishing, shows which kits, pages and sponsors bring people who stay, spots loyal customers ready to become reps, and keeps every recruiting message honest.

listing.pitch: Your head of recruiting: more people joining, from more sponsors, who are still here in 90 days.
highlights: Tracks new reps and enrollments by week, market and kit against your normal
Finds where people drop out of joining, and what stopped them
Shows which kits, pages and shared links bring reps who stay, not just sign-ups
Measures how many reps sponsor anyone, so growth doesn't rest on a few leaders
Spots loyal customers who look ready to become reps
Sends recruiting pages and income mentions to Moderator before anyone uses them
example_prompts: How many people joined this week, and is that normal for November?
Where are people dropping out of our sign-up?
Which enrollment kit brings reps who are still active after 90 days?
How many of our active reps sponsored someone this quarter?
Which customers look ready to become reps?
Why did enrollments in Mexico fall last month?

suggested_triggers.label: Every Monday at 9am: weekly recruiting review
On the 2nd at 10am: monthly growth review
When a customer becomes a rep
